prerequisites: Having passed the subjects Fluid Mechanics and Thermotechnics.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to apply knowledge in practice.
Ability to work in a team.
Aptitude for oral and written communication in the native language.
Ability for autonomous and deep learning.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to analyze and evaluate the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Applied knowledge of the fundamentals of fluid mechanical systems and machines.
To know the fundamentals of the operation of hydraulic machines and thermal turbomachines.
To know and be able to apply design and evaluation techniques for the behavior of hydraulic machines.
To know and be able to apply design and evaluation techniques for the behavior of thermal turbomachines.
To know the typology of the main distribution networks in the industrial and residential sector.
To be able to apply the fundamentals of fluid mechanics and thermotechnics for the design and evaluation of the behavior of said networks.

syllabus_topics: Positive displacement machines: pumps and motors
Fundamental equations, hypotheses and equipment equations (valid for pumps and motors)
Turbines: Action turbines (Velocity triangle. Pelton turbine.)
Turbines: Reaction turbines (Net head. Draft tube equation. Cavitation.)
Hydraulic installations: Stability. Pumps in series and parallel
Hydraulic installations: Starting of centrifugal and axial pumps. Regulation
Pneumatic installations: Introduction to pneumatic energy
Pneumatic installations: Design and calculation of installations
Pipes with service along the route
teaching_methods: Practical sessions, seminars and problem solving
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 30% from theory assessment tests (A), 50% from problem exams (B), and 20% from computer practicals (C).
